texts.zh:
通过对在[From.GetName]星系的未识别舰队的身份码的调查，我们得到了意料之外的发现。舰队实际上并不位于黑洞的安全轨道，而是跨过了事件视界。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]推测舰队在数世纪之前就抵达了[From.GetName]的事件视界，在这里时间膨胀使得舰队在黑洞表面留下了它们的影像。

舰队是有意采取了这样的行动，还是遭受了不幸了事故，我们可能永远无从知晓。它们的身份识别码与所有已知文明都无法匹配。
texts.en:
Investigation of the unrecognized fleet signatures in the [From.GetName] system revealed an unexpected discovery. The fleet is not, in fact, in safe orbit of the black hole, but rather crossing its event horizon.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] conjectures that the fleet approached [From.GetName]'s event horizon centuries ago, whereupon time dilation left their image detectable on its surface.

Whether the fleet's actions were intentional, or the result of some unhappy accident, we may never know. Their signatures match no known civilization on record.

summary.text:
# 舰队的信号 / Fleet Signatures

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:62-80; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:434 (distar.20)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。调查黑洞时，若帝国已与至少一个国家建立通讯，可能生成（4级，权重1）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn when surveying a black hole if the empire has communications with at least one country (level 4, weight 1).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.20“全息图像”：那支“舰队”并非停在轨道上，而是数世纪前越过事件视界的船只，时间膨胀让它们的影像留在视界表面；其信号不属于任何已知文明。黑洞获得社会学矿藏与 black_hole_hologram 修正，帝国获得 seen_event_horizon 标记。30天后的通用接触报告 story.5 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

distar.20 "Hologram": the "fleet" is not in orbit but crossed the event horizon centuries ago; time dilation keeps its image on the horizon, and its signatures match no known civilisation. The black hole gains a society deposit and black_hole_hologram; the empire gets the seen_event_horizon flag. The generic contact report story.5 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.
